== ''Obtainment'' ==
*Has a chance to drop when breaking Infested Leaves.
*Dropped by [[Assimilated Villager|Assimilated]] (5% chance) and [[Assimara Villager|Assimara Villagers]] (10% chance).
*Guaranteed drop from [[Draconite|Draconites]].

== ''Usage'' ==
The False Apple can be eaten, which will grant Hunger and Nausea effects for 30 and 10 seconds respectively. This will also spawn 5 [[Buglin|Buglins]] around the player.

They can also be used to craft the [[Modules#Derived Module|Derived Module]].
{{CraftingTable|r1_b1=Kirin Trophy|r1_a2=Ancient Module|r1_b2=False Apple|r1_c2=Ancient Module|r1_b3=Draconite Trophy|r1_output=Derived Module}}

== ''Trivia'' ==
*The item's name and tooltip are a reference to the game "Limbus Company." "Is it so wrong that I survived?" is a quote from one of the game's characters.
